verdict.line: You lose trades and solo-kill fights before level 6, but Garen's 47.6% winrate over 231 games says the lane closes back to even once Demacian Justice comes online.

brief.thesis: Camille's whole pressure tool is E (Hookshot) — it only knocks up on landing when she jumps off a wall, so this lane is decided by how close to the tree line the wave sits. Away from a wall she has no gap-close and no disengage, leaving only her empowered Q auto and W cone as trade tools, both of which Garen can walk through with E (Judgment). Garen has zero ranged answer to that early poke, which is exactly why Camille owns the pre-6 trades and the solo-kill numbers — but her R (The Hextech Ultimatum) sits on a 140-second cooldown at rank 1, so once your R execute threat exists she loses her answer to your all-in for a long stretch of the mid-game.

theirWindow.when: She's near a wall and E is up
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot to the wall, knock you up on landing, and dump Q/W into the stun window. Don't stand still near lane walls once she has flashed or walked toward one — back off to mid-wave instead.

yourWindow.when: She's away from any wall, E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Hookshot is dead weight without a wall to jump to, so she has no engage and no escape. Step up and land E (Judgment) — 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown means you get this window every fight if you track it.

start.why: Camille's only pre-6 damage source is her empowered Q auto and W autos — Doran's Shield's block-on-hit directly eats that poke and lets you sit on the wave instead of losing HP to every trade.

boots.why: 49.8% winrate over the large 75.4% pick-rate sample — the attack speed lets you land more E (Judgment) ticks in the trade windows she leaves open when E is down.

core.why: The active's slow is your only way to actually pin Camille down once she's used Hookshot to reposition — without it she just walks away after her poke.
More attacks landed per second directly raises your E and auto-attack trade damage during the 9s-cooldown window E is up.
Camille's W heals her on the outer-half hit — grievous wounds cuts that sustain out of her trades entirely. This path posted the best sample winrate at 54.3% over 35 games.

situational.when: you need more mobility to close on her before Hookshot resets her position
she's snowballing off early kills and you need to survive dives rather than win duels
you need grievous wounds online before Mortal Reminder is finished

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's stacking healing offsets her poke damage over an extended fight, which matters because you can't win a single burst exchange against her empowered Q — you have to win the fight she's forced to stay in.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 93.3% of games at a 51.2% winrate — Ignite closes out the kill before Camille's passive shield or W self-heal can reset the trade back to even.

playing.title: Force fights away from walls
playing.detail: Camille's E (Hookshot) only knocks up when she lands off a wall she jumped to. Shove the wave toward the river or open ground where there's nothing for her to jump off, and her all-in disappears.

playing.title: Max E first, Q second
playing.detail: The strongest skill order maxes E (Judgment) by level 9 for trade damage, then Q (Decisive Strike) by level 13 — keep the silence on Q for the fights where you need to shut down her W cast.

playing.title: Save Q's silence for her cast, not the auto
playing.detail: Q breaks any slow on you and silences on the next hit — hold it until she commits to W (Tactical Sweep) or right as she lands Hookshot, not just to poke.

playing.title: Wait out her passive shield
playing.detail: Adaptive Defenses gives Camille a shield against your damage type right after she autos you. Don't dump E immediately into that auto — wait a beat for the shield to drop before committing your burst.

playing.title: All-in the moment you hit 6
playing.detail: Demacian Justice's cooldown is 140/110/80/50/20s and her R sits at 140s at rank 1 — for a long window after level 6 she has no ultimate answer to your execute threat.

playing.title: Respect the delayed Q recast
playing.detail: If she holds her Precision Protocol recast, the second hit does significantly increased damage. If you see her land the first Q and back off instead of following up immediately, disengage rather than trade into it.

playing.title: Play for the mid-game, not lane
playing.detail: You're behind in the pre-6 trade and solo-kill numbers by design of her kit — Stridebreaker and Conqueror are what bring this back to even, so don't force all-ins level 1-5 that the data says you lose.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoner spells, and all winrate/pick-rate figures are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the tactical reading — wall dependency on Hookshot, the passive shield timing, the Q recast tell, and the execute-window analysis — is my own judgement layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not get hit by Camille by considering the range on her (E). Fight her whenever your abilities come off cooldown and try to kill her after reaching level 6.
